name: Link length, each direction
definition: Sum of link length over all highway links (each direction counted). SQL: SELECT SUM(length_m) / 1000.0 AS value FROM links

name: Lane-km, all roads
definition: Sum of link length x lanes over all highway links. SQL: SELECT SUM(length_m * lanes) / 1000.0 AS value FROM links

name: Lane-km, freeways
definition: Sum of link length x lanes over links of class FWY. SQL: SELECT SUM(length_m * lanes) / 1000.0 AS value FROM links WHERE link_class = 'FWY'
